title: Gene Bouchette & Ray Mathison in Control Room, 1960s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A original November 1969 black-and-white photograph capturing Gene Bouchette and Ray Mathison working inside a complex technical room outfitted with instrument panels, gauges, dials, and electronic circuitry. The photo print features a date stamp at the top margin reading '. NOV . 69'.
